D.E.L.T.A. Rescue (Dedication and Everlasting Love to Animals) is the largest "No Kill, Care-for-Life," Sanctuary of its kind in the world.

The D.E.L.T.A. Rescue Super Sanctuary is home to more than 1500 animals that have all been abandoned in the wilderness. The animals at the sanctuary will never have to worry about being lost and alone again.

D.E.L.T.A. Rescue receives no help from the government and relies solely on donor contributions and is tax -exempt 501 [c] 3 organization dedicated to rescuing animals abandoned in the wilderness and stopping the cruel practice of animal abandonment.

D.E.L.T.A. Rescue was awarded BEST IN AMERICA status by Independent Charities of America! In a letter congratulating D.E.L.T.A. Rescue, ICA said to be proud -- only about 3% of the charities they deal with earn this recognition. They study charities, analyze their expenses and their mission, and make a determination.

D.E.L.T.A. Rescue also received a 4 STAR Rating on Charity Navigator.
